senses.gloss: 1. युत् mfn. (for √ 2. युत् See s.v.) keeping off, in द्वेषो-यु॑त्, q.v.
युक् or युत् (?) ind. badly, ill, W.
2. युत् (fr. √ द्युत्; cf. √ जुत् and ज्युत्; for 1. युत् See p. 853, col. 1) cl. 1. Ā. योतते, to shine, Dhātup. ii, 30.
युत् (for 1. See p. 853, col. 1; for 2. See above), in comp. for 2. युध्.
1. युत mfn. (for 2. See below) kept off, removed (see comp.)
separate (= पृथक्), L.
2. युत mfn. (for 1. See above) attached, fastened (ifc.), Bhartṛ.
added, Sūryas.
united, combined, joined or connected or provided or filled or covered with, accompanied by, possessed of (instr. or comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) standing in conjunction with, VarBṛS.
made or consisting of R.
(with instr.) occupied in, performing (sacrifices), L.
(ifc.) connected with, concerning, R.; BhP.
युत n. a partic. measure of length (= 4 Hastas), L.
युत , युतक, युति. See under √ 1. 2. यु.
युत॑—द्वेषस् (युत॑-), mfn. delivered from enemies, RV.
1. युतक n. = यौतक (q.v.), L.
2. युतक mfn. (for 1. See above) joined, connected, L.
युतक n. (only L.) a pair
a sort of cloth or dress
the edge of a cloth or dress
the edge of a winnowing basket
doubt or an asylum (संशय or संश्रय)
friendship or forming friendship.
युति f. uniting, junction, union or meeting with (in astron. ‘conjunction’), Sūryas.; VarBṛS.
the being furnished with or obtaining possession of (instr. or comp.), VarBṛS.
the sum, total number, Sūryas.
the number to be added, Bījag.
यूति See गो- and बहिर्-यूति.
युत्-कार युद्-भू &c. See under 1. युध् below.
युत्—कार॑ mfn. making war, fighting, RV. x, 103, 2.
